mathematics.conditional_update: Existing full Kraus amplitude phi(y-g*lambda_i) times every amplitude; normalization positive; no extra eigenstate projection.
mathematics.gaussian_derivative_bound: Supremum absolute fourth derivative <=(3sqrt(3)exp(-3/2)+3exp(-1/2))/sqrt(2pi)/sigma^4 <1.19/sigma^4 for the normalized common-width Gaussian mixture.
mathematics.slope_limiting_bound: Endpoint derivatives capped in[0,3*adjacent_secant]; add (4h/27)*max_i(|delta_d_i|+|delta_d_(i+1)|) to account for limiter.
mathematics.endpoint_projection_bound: Add max|projected_monotone_CDF-original_CDF|; Hermite value basis is nonnegative and sums to1.
mathematics.tail_bound: Gaussian mixture means bounded; lo=minmu-zsigma,hi=maxmu+zsigma, z=-Phi^-1(tail/2), each omitted tail<=tail/2.
mathematics.float_qualification: 5e-12 table allowance and8gamma_N+32epsilon conditional sum/normalization allowance are explicit conservative engineering budgets, not a formal special-function/BLAS roundoff certificate.
